notes.title: LGM goes mobile !
notes.notes:
Hi everybody! 

Just a little news to tell you that [u][b]I've made an Android version of Little Gold Miner.[/b][/u]
You will find it b[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.lastwhirlwind.LGM]y clicking on this link [/url]:)

The game has been a bit reworked to make it manageable with your smartphone.

Have a nice day ;)
